next:wr:791.hint: 彼はその重いドアを開けようとしたが、開かなかった
next:wr:791.answer: He tried to open the heavy door, but it wouldn't budge.
next:wr:791.fullSentence: He tried to open the heavy door, but it wouldn't budge.
next:wr:791.explanation: try to do『〜しようとする(実際にはできなかった可能性)』。
next:wr:791.relatedInfo: try doing(試しに〜してみる)との対比。

next:wr:793.hint: あなたの気持ちを傷つけるつもりはなかった
next:wr:793.answer: I didn't mean to hurt your feelings.
next:wr:793.fullSentence: I didn't mean to hurt your feelings.
next:wr:793.explanation: mean to do『〜するつもりがある』。
next:wr:793.relatedInfo: mean doing(〜することになる、〜を意味する)との対比。

next:wr:795.hint: あなたに重要なことについて話す必要がある
next:wr:795.answer: I need to talk to you about something important.
next:wr:795.fullSentence: I need to talk to you about something important.
next:wr:795.explanation: need to do『〜する必要がある』。
next:wr:795.relatedInfo: need doing(〜される必要がある)との対比。

next:wr:797.hint: 導入の後、彼女はさらに続けて詳細について話した(別のこと)
next:wr:797.answer: After the introduction, she went on to talk about the details.
next:wr:797.fullSentence: After the introduction, she went on to talk about the details.
next:wr:797.explanation: go on to do『さらに続けて(別のことを)〜する』。
next:wr:797.relatedInfo: go on doing(同じことを続ける)との対比。

next:wr:799.hint: 彼女は山の写真を撮るために立ち止まった(再確認)
next:wr:799.answer: She stopped to take a picture of the mountain.
next:wr:799.fullSentence: She stopped to take a picture of the mountain.
next:wr:799.explanation: stop to do『〜するために立ち止まる』の再確認。
next:wr:799.relatedInfo: stop doing(〜するのをやめる)との対比。

next:wr:801.hint: 彼はその報告書の誤りに気づきそこなった
next:wr:801.answer: He failed to notice the mistake in the report.
next:wr:801.fullSentence: He failed to notice the mistake in the report.
next:wr:801.explanation: fail to do『〜しそこなう、〜することができない』。
next:wr:801.relatedInfo: fail in doing(〜することに失敗する)との対比。

next:wr:803.hint: 引っ越しを手伝ってもらうために弟に頼む必要がある
next:wr:803.answer: I need to get my brother to help me move.
next:wr:803.fullSentence: I need to get my brother to help me move.
next:wr:803.explanation: get A to do『Aに〜させる』。have A doとほぼ同義だが、getはto不定詞を使う点が異なる。
next:wr:803.relatedInfo: get A to do は説得のニュアンスを含むことが多い。

next:wr:805.hint: 今夜までにこれを終わらせなければならない
next:wr:805.answer: I've got to finish this by tonight.
next:wr:805.fullSentence: I've got to finish this by tonight.
next:wr:805.explanation: have got to do (= have to do)『〜しなければならない』。
next:wr:805.relatedInfo: 口語的な表現。've got toはgottaと短縮されることもある。

next:wr:807.hint: この箱を2階に運ぶのを手伝ってください
next:wr:807.answer: Please help me carry this box upstairs.
next:wr:807.fullSentence: Please help me carry this box upstairs.
next:wr:807.explanation: let/make/help + A + do(原形)『Aに〜させる/Aが〜するのを手伝う』。
next:wr:807.relatedInfo: helpは原形不定詞・to不定詞どちらもとれる。

next:wr:809.hint: その会社が閉鎖されると言われるのを聞いた
next:wr:809.answer: I heard it said that the company would close down.
next:wr:809.fullSentence: I heard it said that the company would close down.
next:wr:809.explanation: I heard it said that S+V『…と言われるのを聞いた(=…と言われている)』。
next:wr:809.relatedInfo: itは形式目的語、saidは過去分詞。

next:wr:811.hint: ドアが施錠されていることを確かめた
next:wr:811.answer: I saw that the door was locked.
next:wr:811.fullSentence: I saw that the door was locked.
next:wr:811.explanation: see that S+V『〜だとわかる、〜を確かめる』。知覚動詞see+O+doとは異なりthat節をとる用法。
next:wr:811.relatedInfo: see to it that ~(取り計らう)とは異なる意味。

next:wr:812.hint: その男はもっと勉強すべきだと主張した
next:wr:812.answer: The man insisted that he should study harder.
next:wr:812.fullSentence: The man insisted that he should study harder.
next:wr:812.explanation: insist that S should do(要求・提案のthat節)。
next:wr:812.relatedInfo: 事実の主張ではshouldを使わない直説法になる点と対比。

next:wr:814.hint: 彼らは会社に賠償金を支払うよう要求した
next:wr:814.answer: They demanded that the company pay compensation.
next:wr:814.fullSentence: They demanded that the company pay compensation.
next:wr:814.relatedInfo: 要求を表す動詞のthat節は仮定法現在(原形)を使う。

next:wr:816.hint: 教師はすべての生徒にレポートを提出するよう求めた
next:wr:816.answer: The teacher required that all students submit the report.
next:wr:816.fullSentence: The teacher required that all students submit the report.
next:wr:816.relatedInfo: 要求・提案系の動詞の共通パターン。

next:wr:818.hint: 彼がそんなことを言うとは奇妙だ
next:wr:818.answer: It is strange that he should say such a thing.
next:wr:818.fullSentence: It is strange that he should say such a thing.
next:wr:818.explanation: 感情・当然の判断を表す形容詞+that S should do(このshouldは感情的な意外性を表す)。
next:wr:818.relatedInfo: 要求のshouldとは意味が異なる。

next:wr:820.hint: 何があなたの心を変えさせたのか
next:wr:820.answer: What made you change your mind?
next:wr:820.fullSentence: What made you change your mind?
next:wr:820.relatedInfo: cause/allow/enable等がto doをとるのに対し、使役動詞make/let/haveは原形不定詞をとる。

next:wr:822.hint: 何も彼をあきらめさせることはできなかった
next:wr:822.answer: Nothing could force him to give up.
next:wr:822.fullSentence: Nothing could force him to give up.
next:wr:822.relatedInfo: 強制的な使役の意味を持つ。

next:wr:824.hint: 先週車を修理してもらった
next:wr:824.answer: I had my car repaired last week.
next:wr:824.fullSentence: I had my car repaired last week.
next:wr:824.explanation: have A done『Aを〜してもらう』(第三者による行為)。
next:wr:824.relatedInfo: repairは受動の関係なので過去分詞。

next:wr:826.hint: 先生は生徒たちに試験について警告した
next:wr:826.answer: The teacher warned the students about the exam.
next:wr:826.fullSentence: The teacher warned the students about the exam.
next:wr:826.explanation: warn 人 about ~『人に〜について警告する』。
next:wr:826.relatedInfo: warn 人 of ~ もほぼ同義で使われる。

next:wr:828.hint: 牛乳が腐ってしまった
next:wr:828.explanation: go+形容詞『(悪い方向へ)〜になる』。go bad/mad/wild/flatなど。
next:wr:828.relatedInfo: become(中立的な変化)との違いはネガティブな含みがある点。

next:wr:830.hint: そのままにしておこう。私たちにできることは何もない
next:wr:830.answer: Let it be. There's nothing more we can do.
next:wr:830.fullSentence: Let it be. There's nothing more we can do.
next:wr:830.explanation: Let it be『あるがままにさせておく』。

next:wr:832.hint: その災害を生き延びた種はわずかだった
next:wr:832.answer: Only a few species survived the disaster.
next:wr:832.fullSentence: Only a few species survived the disaster.
next:wr:832.explanation: surviveは自動詞・他動詞両方の用法を持つ(ここでは他動詞用法)。
next:wr:832.relatedInfo: survive inのような前置詞は不要。

next:wr:834.hint: 彼は父親によく似ている
next:wr:834.explanation: resemble Aは他動詞で前置詞不要(×resemble with A)。
next:wr:834.relatedInfo: 進行形にしない状態動詞の一つ。

next:wr:836.hint: 彼らはお金について言い争った
next:wr:836.answer: They argued with each other about money.
next:wr:836.fullSentence: They argued with each other about money.
next:wr:836.explanation: argue with A about B『AとBについて言い争う』。

next:wr:838.hint: 彼は有名な大学を卒業した
next:wr:838.answer: He graduated from a famous university.
next:wr:838.fullSentence: He graduated from a famous university.
next:wr:838.relatedInfo: 日本語の『卒業する』と違い、fromが必要。
